title: Gross anatomy
audience: a medical student in the preclinical years
purpose: Describe the anatomy of the back, thorax, abdomen, pelvis and perineum, limbs, head, neck and cranial nerves, with imaging and clinical correlations.

weeks.10: The head: skull, face and scalp

blocks.deliverable: Explain the anatomy of a lumbar puncture.
Trace the coronary arteries and their territories.
Explain referred pain from the appendix and the gallbladder.
Week 7 midterm; predict deficits from injuries to the brachial plexus.
Explain the anatomy behind a hip fracture and an epidural hematoma.
Localize a cranial nerve lesion from its signs.
Submit the project; take an unseen 150 minute final in week 14.

project: Clinical anatomy portfolio: explain the anatomy behind ten common injuries or procedures, such as a hip fracture, a lumbar puncture or a central line.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
